description.value:
Hidden Mist Technique. The signature ambient jutsu of Kirigakure. You exhale a dense mist that fills a 30-foot emanation centered on you. The mist moves with you.

Creatures within the mist (including you) have the concealed condition. Creatures outside the mist who try to see through it have the concealed condition relative to anything inside.

The mist lasts 10 minutes or until dispelled by a wind-trait spell of equal or higher rank, or by emerging into open daylight.

Heightened (4th) Range extends to 60 feet emanation; creatures inside are hidden instead of concealed if they take any action other than Step.
